final: WITH exam_patient AS (SELECT p.SEX, e."aCL IgG", e.ANA FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID), sex_stats AS (SELECT SEX, AVG("aCL IgG") as avg_igg, AVG(ANA) as A FROM exam_patient GROUP BY SEX), B_calc AS (SELECT AVG(A) as B FROM sex_stats WHERE A IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_igg, s.A, s.A / b.B as ratio FROM sex_stats s CROSS JOIN B_calc b WHERE b.B IS NOT NULL
